text: For the one directing. A Psalm of David. A Song. 1 To You praise [is] waiting, O God, in Zion, and to You the vow will be fulfilled.
O Hearer of prayer, to You all flesh will come.
Matters of iniquities prevail against me—our transgressions, You wipe them away!
Blessed [is the one] You choose and bring near, [that] he may dwell in Your courts; we will be satisfied with the goodness of Your house, the holiness of Your temple.
[With] fearsome [things], may You answer us in righteousness, O God of our salvation, the confidence [for] all the farthest ends of the earth and the sea,
the One establishing the mountains by His strength, being girded with might,
stilling the roaring of the seas, the roar of their waves, and the uproar of the peoples.
And those dwelling [at] the ends were afraid of Your signs; the goings forth of morning and evening You cause to sing.
You attend to the earth and give it abundance; greatly You enrich it; the stream of God is full of water; You provide their grain when thus You prepare it—
soaking its furrows, descending [on] its ridges; with showers You soften it; its springing up You bless.
You crown the year [with] Your goodness, and Your tracks drip [with] fatness.
They drip [on] the pastures of the wilderness, and the hills are surrounded [with] joy.
The meadows are clothed [with] the flock, and the valleys are feeble with grain—they shout [for joy] [and] even sing.
